text: All division/remainder operations shall cause terminal `integer_divide_by_zero` on zero divisor. `sdiv(MIN_N,-1)` shall cause terminal `integer_divide_overflow`; `srem(MIN_N,-1)` shall return zero without executing a quotient-overflow fault.
